experiment.name: phase9_multidomain_capability_composition_v2_2
experiment.primary_question: Can a tiny short-response student gain broad reasoning while preserving specialized RAG, procedural, abstention, and social abilities when capability updates are isolated and composed instead of trained sequentially?
experiment.frozen_anchor_rule: Every independent adapter is trained from the exact same materialized input student. Sequential specialist fine-tuning is forbidden in the controlled composition tracks.

data.design: Prompt-contained reasoning operations, deterministic short gold answers, train-only specialist rehearsal, no visible chain-of-thought and no encyclopedic fact memorization.

A_broad_reasoning.purpose: Fresh broad multi-domain adapter from the frozen anchor.

B_anchored_reasoning.purpose: Broad reasoning plus 20% supervised preservation rehearsal and forward KL(anchor || student).

C_parallel_specialists.purpose: Five independent LoRA deltas trained from the identical frozen anchor for clean causal attribution.

layer_separated.purpose: Pre-registered interference experiment, not a claim that capabilities are known to localize to these exact layers.

axes: original Phase 9 Real-RAG preservation under query_aware_v21
evaluation.null_metric_policy: Protected metrics that are missing/null make a candidate technically invalid for official selection. Missing preservation evidence never becomes zero preservation cost.
evaluation.sealed_policy: Select one DEV winner only. TEST runs once on the frozen winner with frozen DEV retrieval calibrations and no retraining or candidate switching.

safety.high_stakes_dataset_policy: Legal, health, and finance examples teach stated-rule reasoning and conservative uncertainty; they do not encode external professional advice as facts.
